core_memories: Itachi achieves Perfect Cosmic Timelines mastery (Critical Success), gaining galactic-scale chronal manipulation and synchronizing Planetary Seed cultivation, momentarily confusing the Prime Matriarch.
Itachi confronts and subsumes Extra-Cosmic Observer (Critical Success), becoming an absolute multiversal singularity and the ultimate principle of Order. CAMPAIGN CONCLUDED.
Itachi harmonizes Cosmic Timelines (Critical Success), gaining access to residual informational energy from nullified timelines and achieving Perfect Chronal Synchronization.
Itachi explicitly reveals to Sasuke his direct role in the Uchiha Clan Massacre, framing it as a necessary act for his absolute Order.
Itachi (overriding his own logic) reintroduces limited free will into the multiverse, incurring 1 level of Fatigue. The Infinite Tsukuyomi adapts to allow controlled variance within absolute laws.
Itachi contemplates elevating Sasuke to Six Paths Sage level, concluding it is feasible and a logical optimization for his absolute Order.
Itachi experiments with existential reality (Critical Success), gaining mastery over the 'primordial code,' instant pocket universe creation, and consciousness manipulation.

Itachi elevates Sasuke to Six Paths Sage level (Critical Success), granting him ultimate power, localized temporal manipulation, and conceptual loyalty, creating a second absolute pillar for the Order.

Itachi introduces controlled challenges (Critical Success), gaining insight into emergent system guidance, establishing a cosmic feedback loop, and understanding the ultimate efficiency of controlled chaos.
